title.en: Kuldeep reels West Indies in, Gill and Kohli tons knock them out

note: ESPNcricinfo returned 403 to the fetcher: quotes are paraphrases from match coverage. Replace with verbatim quotes from the saved page before publishing.

text.en: West Indies made 295 for 7, with a century from Justin Greaves (101).
India won by eight wickets with 50 balls to spare.

facts.quote: India won by 8 wickets (with 50 balls remaining)

text.en: Virat Kohli made 139 not out off 88 balls; Shubman Gill made 110.
Kuldeep Yadav took 4 for 40 and was player of the match.

facts.quote: Kuldeep Yadav 4/40, Player of the Match

text.en: The match was played at the Greenfield International Stadium in Thiruvananthapuram.

intro.en: You are India, chasing 296 in 50 overs. Every tap plays a whole over: hit when the ball reaches the bat line. The closer to the line, the more runs. Swing far too early or too late and you lose a wicket.

controls.en: Tap the pitch, press the button or press Space.

india.en: India needed 41.4 overs in the real match.

pitch.en: Pitch: the ball travels down towards the bat line.
